verdict.rationale: RudderStack's first-party Transformations docs say transformations filter, enrich, and reshape event data before it reaches destinations. Users write them in custom JavaScript or Python and run them in flight. Supporting features include test cases, reusable libraries, versioning, geolocation enrichment and API management. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-pipeline transformations.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can transform, filter, and enrich events in-pipeline with custom code or functions before they reach destinations

citations.quote: Transformations let you filter, enrich, and reshape event data before it reaches your destinations.
Transformations Clean and enrich events with custom JavaScript and Python
Endless flexibility to transform your event data in flight with JavaScript or Python
Fetch geolocation information from IP address using RudderStack’s geolocation API
Reuse transformation code with transformation libraries
